description: This Java source file implements the CommandConsumerFactoryImpl class, which manages creation and lifecycle of command consumers and response senders for an AMQP 1.0 messaging network within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles tenant, device, and gateway-specific command consumers, including liveness checks and rerouting logic.

classes.name: CommandConsumerFactoryImpl
classes.description: Manages creation and lifecycle of command consumers and response senders, including liveness checks and rerouting logic within the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: CommandConsumerFactoryImpl.LivenessCheckData
classes.description: Holds data related to the liveness check timer for a destination command consumer, including command handlers to re-register upon recreation.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a tenant- and device-specific command consumer with optional gateway ID and liveness check interval.

methods.name: doCreateCommandConsumer
methods.description: Internal method to set up command consumers, handle conflicts, and manage liveness checks.

methods.name: getOrCreateMappingAndDelegatingCommandConsumer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a tenant-scoped consumer that maps and delegates commands.

methods.name: newMappingAndDelegatingCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a new tenant-scoped consumer that handles command mapping and delegation.

methods.name: registerLivenessCheck
methods.description: Registers a periodic liveness check for a command consumer, re-creating consumers if needed.

methods.name: newLivenessCheck
methods.description: Creates a handler that performs the liveness check, including re-creation of consumers if they are not alive.

methods.name: getCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Creates a new command response sender link for a tenant and reply ID.

methods.name: getLegacyCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Creates a legacy command response sender link for a tenant and reply ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the AMQP network and gateway mapper.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the AMQP network and gateway mapper.
